selected_script.angle: Organizing jammed kitchen drawers by relocating tea tins, spice jars, and measuring spoons onto the side of the refrigerator using magnetic metal racks
selected_script.hook: Stop jamming your tea tins and measuring spoons into stuck, overcrowded kitchen drawers.

script_record.pain_point: Kitchen drawers getting jammed and overcrowded with rolling tea tins, small spice jars, and loose measuring spoons.
script_record.conflict_hook: A hand struggling to open a stuck kitchen drawer that is completely cluttered and jammed.
script_record.product_solution: Placing a matte black magnetic spice rack on the side of the fridge to instantly hold the jars and hang the spoons.

timeline.scene: Handheld phone video of a person struggling to pull open a jammed kitchen drawer. The drawer opens slightly to reveal a mess of rolling tea tins, spice jars, and loose measuring spoons blocking the drawer track.

A clean matte black rectangular metal rack is placed directly onto the side of a stainless steel refrigerator, snapping firmly. The rolling jars and tins are immediately placed into the rack's flat bottom tray.
A close-up shot of a hand placing a glass jar next to the tins in the matte black rack, showing the rack holds up to 11 lbs without slipping down.
Close-up shot of detachable metal hooks hanging from the bottom edge of the matte black rack. A hand easily hangs a set of measuring spoons and a small oven mitt onto the hooks.

A wider shot of two identical matte black magnetic racks aligned vertically on the side of the fridge, holding multiple jars neatly. In the background, the previously jammed kitchen drawer is now closed cleanly.
Text on screen: 'Keep your kitchen drawers clutter-free.' The camera slowly pans over the organized side of the fridge.

Do not change the color, shape, or material. Do not invent extra accessories. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment.
